block.text: Sarah and Jessica arrive in New Zealand for a holiday. They find a mobile phone in the taxi from the airport. It is Michael’s mobile, but can they find him? He has messages from home - are they important? Go with the girls on a New Zealand adventure.

contents.content: Sarah e Jessica chegam à Nova Zelândia para passar férias. Elas encontram um celular no táxi que as levou do aeroporto. É o celular de Michael, mas será que elas conseguem encontrá-lo? Ele *recebe mensagens de casa — sao importantes? Acompanhe as garotas em uma aventura na Nova Zelândia.

contents.content: Auckland é uma cidade importante no norte da Ilha Norte da Nova Zelândia.

block.text: Sarah and Jessica are going to New Zealand for a holiday. They are very excited. Jessica is near the window! “Look!”, she says. “There's Auckland!” We’re here!” “But we’re late,” Sarah answers. “When’s our bus?” “At one o’clock,” Jessica says. “We can get a taxi from the airport to the bus station.”

contents.content: Sarah e Jessica vão para a Nova Zelândia para passar férias. Elas estão muito animadas. Jessica está perto da janela! — “Olhe!” diz ela. “Lá está Auckland! Chegamos! Mas estamos atrasadas,” responde Sarah. — “Que horas é o nosso ônibus?” — “À uma hora,” diz Jessica. — “Podemos pegar um táxi do aeroporto até a estação de ônibus.”

exercises.title: 1. Fill in the blank with the correct answer.

block.text: because they’re going to New Zealand.
a taxi from the airport to the bus station.

At the airport, the girls look for a taxi. “Look!” Jessica says. “That boy’s waving to us!” “Excuse me! Are you late?” the boy calls to them. “Do you want this taxi? I can wait.” “Thank you very much!” the girls answer. “To the bus station, please,” Sarah says to the driver. She smiles at the boy and they drive away.

contents.content: No aeroporto, as meninas procuram um táxi. “Olhe!” diz Jessica. “Aquele garoto está acenando para nós!” “Com licença! Vocês estão atrasadas?” chama o garoto. “Querem este táxi? Posso esperar.” “Muito obrigada!” respondem as meninas. “Até a estação de ônibus, por favor,” diz Sarah ao motorista. Ela sorri para o garoto e eles partem.

exercises.title: 2. Fill in the blank with the correct answer.

block.text: 2.1 What do the girls do when they get to the airport? They

The taxi stops at the bus station. Suddenly, Jessica sees a mobile phone on the taxi floor. “Is that your mobile phone?” she asks the driver. He looks at it. “No,” he answers. “It’s the boy’s mobile.” Sarah takes it. Perhaps I can find his address,” she says. “Yes! His name’s Michael. Tomorrow he’s at Ninety Mile Beach. We can give it to him there.”

contents.content: O táxi para na estação de ônibus. De repente, Jessica vê um celular no chão do táxi. “Esse é o seu celular?” ela pergunta ao motorista. Ele olha para ele. “Não,” responde ele. “É o celular do garoto.” Sarah pega o celular. “Talvez eu consiga encontrar o endereço dele,” diz ela. “Sim! O nome dele é Michael. Amanhã ele estará na Ninety Mile Beach. Podemos entregar para ele lá.

exercises.title: 3. Fill in the blank with the correct answer.

block.text: 3.1 What does Sarah do when she sees the phone on the taxi floor? She

The girls wait at Ninety Mile Beach. They eat and watch the buses. The buses aren’t driving on a road—they are driving on the long beach. “Look for Michael!” Jessica says. But Sarah is looking at the sea. Suddenly, Jessica sees him. “He’s on that bus!” she says. She waves. Michael waves to her, but the bus doesn’(t) stop.

contents.content: As meninas esperam na Ninety Mile Beach. Elas comem e observam os ônibus. Os ônibus não estão passando por uma estrada — eles estão passando pela longa praia. “Procurem por Michael!” diz Jessica. Mas Sarah está olhando para o mar. De repente, Jessica o vê. “Ele está naquele ônibus!” diz ela. Ela acena. Michael acena para ela, mas o ônibus não para.

exercises.title: 4. Fill in the blank with the correct answer.

block.text: 4.1 What do the girls do at the Ninety Beach? They

The girls get on a bus. “Can we catch (h)im?” Jessica asks. “I don’(t) know,” Sarah answers. “I can’(t) see his bus now.” Suddenly, they hear a beep. Sarah looks at the mobile. “There’s a message for Michael,” she says. She reads the message. “It’s important,” she says. “Perhaps we can find (h)im tomorrow a(t) the Sky Tower in Auckland.”

contents.content: As meninas entram em um ônibus. “Será que conseguimos alcançá-lo?” pergunta Jessica. “Não sei,” responde Sarah. “Não consigo ver o ônibus dele agora.” De repente, elas ouvem um bip. Sarah olha para o celular. “Há uma mensagem para Michael,” diz ela. Ela lê a mensagem. “É importante,” diz ela. “Talvez possamos encontrá-lo amanhã na Sky Tower em Auckland.

exercises.title: 5. Fill in the blank with the correct answer.

block.text: 5.1 Suddenly, they hear a beep. Sarah

At the Sky Tower, the girls can’(t) see Michael. “He isn’(t) here,” Sarah says. A woman bungy jumps from the tower. “I can do that,” she says. “Are you coming, Jessica?” “No,” Jessica answers. “But I can watch you from here.” “Please watch my bag too,” Sarah says. She gives her bag to Jessica and she goes up the tower.

contents.content: Na Sky Tower, as meninas não conseguem ver Michael. “Ele não está aqui,” diz Sarah. Uma mulher pula de bungy jump da torre. “Eu consigo fazer isso,” diz ela. “Você vem, Jessica?” “Não,” responde Jessica. “Mas posso te ver daqui.” “Por favor, cuide da minha bolsa também,” diz Sarah. Ela entrega a bolsa para Jessica e sobe na torre.

exercises.title: 6. Fill in the blank with the correct answer.

block.text: 6.1 What does Sarah give to Jessica? She

Sarah jumps. It is a very long jump. She comes down near the street and she sees Michael. Jessica sees him, too. “Michael! Come back! We’ve got your mobile!” she calls to him. But Michael is walking away. She runs after him. She doesn’t take Sarah’s bag. “Jessica! My bag!” Sarah calls.

contents.content: Sarah salta. É um salto muito longo. Ela desce perto da rua e vê Michael. Jessica também o vê. — “Michael! Volte! Nós temos o seu celular!” — ela grita. Mas Michael está se afastando. Ela corre atrás dele. Ela não pega a bolsa de Sarah. — “Jessica! Minha bolsa!” — Sarah grita.

exercises.title: 7. Fill in the blank with the correct answer.

block.text: 7.1 At the top of the tower Sarah

Jessica and Sarah are very unhappy. They can’t find Michael and they can’t find Sarah’s bag. Sarah has no money now. “Sorry,” Jessica says. “But I’ve got some money—and we’ve got tickets for the Glow-worm Caves.” “OK. Let’s go there tomorrow,” Sarah says. “Michael is going, too. We can look for him there.”

contents.content: Jessica e Sarah estão muito chateadas. Elas não conseguem encontrar Michael e também não encontram a bolsa de Sarah. Agora, a Sarah não tem dinheiro. “Desculpe,” diz Jessica. “Mas eu tenho um pouco de dinheiro — e nós temos ingressos da Glow-worm Caves.” “OK. Vamos lá amanhã,” diz Sarah. “Michael também vai. Podemos procurá-lo lá.”

exercises.title: 8. Fill in the blank with the correct answer.

block.text: Michael, Sarah’s bag and they don’t

The girls go on a boat into the dark cave. The lights from the glow-worm are very beautiful and it is very quiet. Suddenly, there is a beep from Michael’s mobile. The lights go dark. The people in the boat are angry. “No mobiles!” they say. “We’re very sorry,” Sarah says. She sees a new message for Michael. “Perhaps we can find him in Rotorua.”

contents.content: As meninas entram em um barco e vão para a caverna escura. As luzes do “glow-worm” são muito bonitas e está muito silencioso. De repente, ouve-se um bip do celular de Michael. As luzes se apagam. As pessoas no barco ficam irritadas. — “Sem celulares!” dizem elas. — “Me Desculpe,” diz Sarah. Ela vê uma nova mensagem para Michael. — “Talvez possamos encontrá-lo em Rotorua.

exercises.title: 9. Fill in the blank with the correct answer.

block.text: 9.1 How do the girls get into the dark cave? They

“Rotorua is very interesting,” Jessica says. “I like the hot water.” “Yes,” Sarah answers, “but I can’t see Michael.” “Where is he tomorrow?” Jessica asks. Sarah looks at the mobile, “He’s in the South Island,” she says. “The boat’s very expensive. Can we go?” “Yes,” Jessica says. “I’ve got money for the tickets.”

contents.content: “Rotorua é muito interessante,” diz Jessica. “Eu gosto das águas termais.” — “Sim,” responde Sarah, “mas não consigo ver o Michael.” — “Onde ele estará amanhã?” pergunta Jessica. Sarah olha para o celular. “Ele está na “South Island”,” diz ela. — “O barco é muito caro. Podemos ir?” — “Sim,” diz Jessica. “Eu tenho dinheiro para os ingressos.”

exercises.title: 10. Fill in the blank with the correct answer.

block.text: Sarah and Jessica take a boat to the South Island. It is very cold, and the café is expensive. Suddenly, there is a beep from Michael’s mobile phone. “Oh, no! Not again!” Sarah says. She reads the message. “Michael’s mother and father are worrying about him, and we can’t find him. Let’s take his mobile phone to the police station in Kaikoura.”

contents.content: Sarah e Jessica pegam um barco para a Ilha Sul. Está muito frio, e o café é caro. De repente, ouve-se um bip do celular de Michael. “Oh, não! De novo!” diz Sarah. Ela lê a mensagem. “A mãe e o pai do Michael estão preocupados com ele, e nós não conseguimos encontrá-lo. Vamos levar o seu celular para a delegacia em Kaikoura.

exercises.title: 11.1 Fill in the blank with the correct answer.

block.text: The girls take the phone to the police station. Then they go down to the sea. “Let’s go and see the whales,” Jessica says. “We can’t,” Sarah answers. “The tickets are expensive.” Suddenly, Jessica sees Michael. She runs to him. “Your mobile’s at the police station.” she says, “and you’ve got messages from home.”

contents.content: As meninas levam o celular para a delegacia. Depois, descem até o mar. — “Vamos ver as baleias,” diz Jessica. — “Não podemos,” responde Sarah. “Os ingressos são caros.” De repente, Jessica vê Michael. Ela corre até ele. — “Seu celular está na delegacia,” diz ela, “e você tem mensagens de casa.”

exercises.title: 12. Fill in the blank with the correct answer.

block.text: 12.1 They can't see the whales because the tickets are

Michael quickly calls home. He smiles. “My mother and father are well,” he says, “and they’ve got £100,000 from the lottery! They’re sending some money to me for my holiday. Now I can give you a surprise.” “What surprise?” Jessica asks. “Wait and see,” Michael says. He walks to the Whale Watch ticket office.

contents.content: Michael liga rapidamente para casa. Ele sorri. — “Minha mãe e meu pai estão bem,” diz ele, “e ganharam £100.000 (libras) na loteria! Eles vão me enviar um pouco de dinheiro para as férias. Agora eu posso dar a vocês uma surpresa.” — “Que surpresa?” pergunta Jessica. — “Espere para ver,” diz Michael. Ele caminha até a bilheteria do Whale Watch.

exercises.title: 13. Fill in the blank with the correct answer.

block.text: 13.1 After Michael gets the phone back he

“Thank you for my mobile,” Michael says to the girls. “Thank you for the surprise,” Jessica says. She is very excited. “Do you like the whales?” Michael asks. “I love them,” Jessica answers. “They’re beautiful.” “Yes, and New Zealand is beautiful too,” Sarah says. “This is an adventure!”

contents.content: “Obrigado pelo meu celular,” diz Michael às meninas. — “Obrigada pela surpresa,” diz Jessica. Ela está muito animada. — “Você gosta das baleias?” pergunta Michael. — “Eu as adoro,” responde Jessica. “Elas são lindas.” — “Sim, e a Nova Zelândia também é linda,” diz Sarah. “Que aventura!”
